units.name: CO2 feed compressor
units.purpose: Compress purchased CO2 from battery-limit pressure to synthesis pressure.

units.name: H2 feed compressor
units.purpose: Compress purchased hydrogen from battery-limit pressure to synthesis pressure.

units.name: Synthesis feed mixer
units.purpose: Mix fresh compressed feeds with compressed recycle gas.

units.name: Feed effluent exchanger
units.purpose: Recover reactor-effluent heat to preheat synthesis feed without purchased preheat.

units.name: Methanol synthesis reactor
units.purpose: Convert CO2 and H2 to methanol and water in cooled catalyst-filled tubes while also allowing RWGS to CO.

units.name: Effluent condenser
units.purpose: Cool reactor effluent after heat recovery to condense methanol and water.

units.name: High pressure knockout
units.purpose: Separate condensed crude methanol and water from unreacted synthesis gas and CO.

units.name: Recycle purge splitter
units.purpose: Purge CO and feed impurities while returning most unreacted gas to synthesis.

units.name: Recycle compressor
units.purpose: Restore recycle-loop pressure drop before remixing recycle with fresh feeds.

units.name: Methanol purification
units.purpose: Distill crude condensate to specification methanol and an aqueous bottoms stream.

units.name: Cooling water system
units.purpose: Supply and reject condenser cooling duty through the plant cooling-water utility.

units.name: Wastewater treatment and plant offsites
units.purpose: Treat aqueous methanol-process bottoms and account for common plant infrastructure.

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: No in-situ regeneration is assumed because the literature does not establish a common regeneration protocol across catalyst families; spent catalyst is periodically replaced and annualized.

product_compression.excluded: Specification methanol leaves distillation as a pressurized liquid at the required 5 bar battery-limit condition, so no separate product compressor is required.
